id.title: ‘Tahap Kedua Relokasi Lembaga Publik dan Perluasan Jaringan Transportasi’… Akankah Pembangunan ya...
id.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8559085

[Judul]

Pada paruh pertama tahun ini, kebijakan SOC jangka menengah hingga panjang nasional, termasuk jaringan kereta api dan jalan tol, akan diselesaikan dan diumumkan secara resmi satu demi satu.

Relokasi tambahan lembaga publik juga diharapkan akan menjadi kenyataan.

Provinsi Jeonbuk berencana untuk merespons guna menghilangkan stigma sebagai "daerah terpencil dalam hal transportasi."

Laporan oleh reporter Lee Su-jin.

[Laporan]

Rencana untuk infrastruktur nasional utama, termasuk kereta api, jalan tol, jaringan transportasi wilayah metropolitan, dan rencana jalan nasional dan provinsi, akan terbentuk satu demi satu pada paruh pertama tahun ini.

Menteri Pertanahan, Infrastruktur, dan Transportasi Kim Yun-duk, yang secara resmi mengumumkan realisasi "Kota Mega 2 Juta" di Jeonbuk pada pertemuan balai kota Februari lalu, menyatakan bahwa ini semua adalah proyek inti Kementerian dan berjanji untuk memenuhi tanggung jawabnya untuk memastikan proyek-proyek tersebut menjadi peluang bagi Jeonbuk. [Kim Yun-duk / Menteri Pertanahan, Infrastruktur, dan Transportasi / 29 bulan lalu: "Kementerian Pertanahan, Infrastruktur, dan Transportasi akan menyelesaikan rancangannya. Termasuk relokasi lembaga administrasi dan publik... Pada kenyataannya, banyak hal ditentukan oleh bagaimana infrastruktur jaringan kelembagaan nasional berkembang."]

Selain itu, rencana untuk merelokasi 300 lembaga administrasi dan publik tambahan diharapkan akan diumumkan dalam tahun ini.

Menteri Kim menyatakan bahwa kementerian sedang meninjau langkah-langkah untuk memaksimalkan efektivitas dengan mempertimbangkan situasi bisnis lokal, lembaga penelitian, dan universitas, daripada sekadar merelokasi lembaga.

[Kim Yun-duk / Menteri Pertanahan, Infrastruktur, dan Transportasi / 29 bulan lalu: "Akan lebih baik untuk meninjau perusahaan-perusahaan utama (perusahaan terkemuka), lembaga penelitian, dan bahkan universitas agar hal ini dapat diimplementasikan sepenuhnya."]

Karena Kementerian Pertanahan, Infrastruktur, dan Transportasi mengambil peran aktif, Provinsi Jeonbuk juga mencurahkan upayanya ke dalam proyek-proyek terkait.

Secara khusus, fokus utamanya adalah perluasan jalan tol dan jaringan jalan nasional, termasuk jalan raya, kereta api, dan bandara di dalam Saemangeum.

[Choi Jeong-il / Direktur Jenderal Biro Konstruksi dan Transportasi, Provinsi Jeonbuk: "Ketika perusahaan datang ke daerah tersebut, SOC (Infrastruktur Sosial) pada dasarnya berarti meningkatkan aksesibilitas. Kebetulan, karena tahun ini adalah waktu untuk menetapkan rencana nasional, yang terjadi setiap lima tahun, waktunya tampaknya sangat tepat."]

Kebijakan pembangunan yang seimbang sangat dibutuhkan di Jeonbuk.

Perhatian difokuskan pada seberapa nyata hasil dari kebijakan-kebijakan ini.

Ini adalah Lee Su-jin dari KBS News.

Juru Kamera: Ahn Gwang-seok

snippet.title: “민주당 후보이기에 돋보이는 것”…텃밭 사수 나선 민주당 / KBS  2026.05.12.
snippet.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8559069

[앵커]

 더불어민주당이  전남에서 호남권 공천자 대회를 열며 텃밭 다지기에 나섰습니다.

 정청래 대표는 후보들이 민주당이기에  돋보이는 거라고 강조했는데요.

 김관영 예비후보는  민심을 제대로 파악하지 못하고 있다며 맞섰습니다.

 진유민 기자가 보도합니다.

 [리포트] 

6·3 지방선거에 나설 전북 지역 민주당 후보들이 모두 한자리에 모였습니다.

 이재명 정부에서  전북 발전을 위해선 민주당 후보가 당선돼야 한다며 승리를 다짐했습니다.

 정청래 당대표는 공천장을 받은 후보들이 돋보이는 건 민주당이 품고 있기 때문이라며 무소속 출마를 에둘러 겨냥했습니다.

 [정청래/더불어민주당 대표 : "여기 와 계신 후보들께서는 히말라야산맥 같은 더불어민주당 후보이기 때문에 돋보인다고 생각해야 합니다."]

 호남에서 단 한석의  무소속 후보도 당선돼선 안 된다며 공세를 높인 민주당, 이성윤 최고위원은 김관영 예비후보를  직접적으로 비판하며 견제에 나섰습니다.

 [이성윤/더불어민주당 최고위원 : "(김관영 예비후보가) 자신이 저지른 행위는 뒤로 하고 우리 민주당 탓이라는 식으로 말하면서 피해자인 양 전북 도민에게 말하고 있습니다."]

 민주당이 텃밭인 전북에서 민심 단속에 나선 가운데, 행사장 밖에선 전북도지사 등 일부 지역 공천 결과에 반발한 항의성 집회가 이어졌습니다.

 김관영 예비후보 측은 이미 전북에서 '무소속 돌풍'이 일고 있다며, '정 대표 사당화'에 분노하는 민심을 제대로 파악하지 못한 민주당 지도부의 '면피성 처방'이라고 강하게 비판했습니다.

 KBS 뉴스 진유민입니다.

 촬영기자:정종배

 김관영 예비후보 측은 이미 전북에서 '무소속 돌풍'이 일고 있다며, '정 대표 사당화'에 분노하는 민심을 제대로 파악하지 못한 민주당 지도부의 '면피성 처방'이라고 강하게 비판했습니다.

en-US.title: “Standing out because he is a Democratic candidate”… Democratic Party sets out to defend its stro...
en-US.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8559069

[Anchor]

The Democratic Party of Korea has set out to solidify its stronghold by holding a convention for nominees from the Honam region in South Jeolla Province.

Party Leader Jeong Cheong-rae emphasized that the candidates stand out because they are from the Democratic Party.

Preliminary candidate Kim Kwan-young countered, stating that the party is failing to properly grasp public sentiment.

Reporter Jin Yu-min reports.

[Report]

All Democratic Party candidates from the North Jeolla region running in the June 3 local elections gathered in one place.

They pledged victory, stating that a Democratic Party candidate must be elected for the development of North Jeolla under the Lee Jae-myung administration.

Party Leader Jeong Cheong-rae indirectly targeted independent candidacies, saying that the reason candidates who have received nominations stand out is because they are embraced by the Democratic Party.

[Jeong Cheong-rae / Leader of the Democratic Party: "The candidates present here should consider that they stand out because they are candidates of the Democratic Party, which is like the Himalayas."]

The Democratic Party, having intensified its offensive by asserting that not a single independent candidate should be elected in the Honam region, saw Supreme Council Member Lee Seong-yun take action to keep preliminary candidate Kim Kwan-young in check by directly criticizing him.

[Lee Seong-yun / Supreme Council Member of the Democratic Party: "(Preliminary candidate Kim Kwan-young) is putting aside his own actions and speaking to the residents of Jeonbuk as if he were a victim, blaming the Democratic Party."]

As the Democratic Party tightened its grip on public sentiment in its stronghold of Jeonbuk, protest rallies continued outside the venue in opposition to the nomination results for some regions, including the Jeonbuk Governor.

Preliminary candidate Kim Kwan-young's camp strongly criticized the Democratic Party leadership, stating that an "independent whirlwind" is already sweeping through Jeonbuk and that this is a "face-saving measure" by the leadership that failed to properly grasp the public sentiment angered by the "privatization of the party by Representative Jeong." This is Jin Yu-min for KBS News.

Cameraman: Jeong Jong-bae

ko.title: “민주당 후보이기에 돋보이는 것”…텃밭 사수 나선 민주당 / KBS  2026.05.12.
ko.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8559069

[앵커]

 더불어민주당이  전남에서 호남권 공천자 대회를 열며 텃밭 다지기에 나섰습니다.

 정청래 대표는 후보들이 민주당이기에  돋보이는 거라고 강조했는데요.

 김관영 예비후보는  민심을 제대로 파악하지 못하고 있다며 맞섰습니다.

 진유민 기자가 보도합니다.

 [리포트] 

6·3 지방선거에 나설 전북 지역 민주당 후보들이 모두 한자리에 모였습니다.

 이재명 정부에서  전북 발전을 위해선 민주당 후보가 당선돼야 한다며 승리를 다짐했습니다.

 정청래 당대표는 공천장을 받은 후보들이 돋보이는 건 민주당이 품고 있기 때문이라며 무소속 출마를 에둘러 겨냥했습니다.

 호남에서 단 한석의  무소속 후보도 당선돼선 안 된다며 공세를 높인 민주당, 이성윤 최고위원은 김관영 예비후보를  직접적으로 비판하며 견제에 나섰습니다.

id.title: “Menonjol karena dia adalah kandidat Demokrat”… Partai Demokrat berupaya mempertahankan bentengny...
id.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8559069

[Judul Berita]

Partai Demokrat Korea berupaya memperkuat posisinya dengan mengadakan konvensi bagi para calon dari wilayah Honam di Provinsi Jeolla Selatan.

Pemimpin Partai Jeong Cheong-rae menekankan bahwa para kandidat tersebut menonjol karena mereka berasal dari Partai Demokrat.

Calon sementara Kim Kwan-young membantah, menyatakan bahwa partai tersebut gagal memahami sentimen publik dengan baik.

Laporan oleh Reporter Jin Yu-min.

[Laporan]

Semua kandidat Partai Demokrat dari wilayah Jeolla Utara yang maju dalam pemilihan lokal 3 Juni berkumpul di satu tempat.

Mereka berjanji akan menang, menyatakan bahwa kandidat Partai Demokrat harus terpilih untuk pembangunan Jeolla Utara di bawah pemerintahan Lee Jae-myung.

Ketua Partai Jeong Cheong-rae secara tidak langsung menargetkan kandidat independen, dengan mengatakan bahwa alasan kandidat yang telah menerima nominasi menonjol adalah karena mereka dirangkul oleh Partai Demokrat.

[Jeong Cheong-rae / Ketua Partai Demokrat: "Para kandidat yang hadir di sini harus mempertimbangkan bahwa mereka menonjol karena mereka adalah kandidat Partai Demokrat, yang seperti Himalaya."]

Partai Demokrat, setelah meningkatkan serangannya dengan menegaskan bahwa tidak satu pun kandidat independen boleh terpilih di wilayah Honam, melihat Anggota Dewan Tertinggi Lee Seong-yun mengambil tindakan untuk mengendalikan kandidat sementara Kim Kwan-young dengan mengkritiknya secara langsung.

[Lee Seong-yun / Anggota Dewan Tertinggi Partai Demokrat: "(Calon sementara Kim Kwan-young) mengesampingkan tindakannya sendiri dan berbicara kepada penduduk Jeonbuk seolah-olah dia adalah korban, menyalahkan Partai Demokrat."]

Saat Partai Demokrat memperketat cengkeramannya pada sentimen publik di bentengnya di Jeonbuk, demonstrasi protes terus berlanjut di luar tempat acara sebagai penentangan terhadap hasil nominasi untuk beberapa daerah, termasuk Gubernur Jeonbuk.

Kubu calon sementara Kim Kwan-young mengkritik keras kepemimpinan Partai Demokrat, menyatakan bahwa "pusaran angin independen" telah menyapu Jeonbuk dan bahwa ini adalah "tindakan penyelamatan muka" oleh kepemimpinan yang gagal memahami sentimen publik yang marah atas "privatisasi partai oleh Perwakilan Jeong." Ini adalah Jin Yu-min untuk KBS News.

Juru Kamera: Jeong Jong-bae

snippet.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8558070

쾌청했던 주말과 달리  오늘은 전북 곳곳에 비가 내리고 있습니다.

 돌풍과 천둥, 번개를 동반한 요란한 비가 예상되는데요.

 대기가 불안정한 곳에는 우박이 떨어질 수도 있겠습니다. 

 내일까지 20에서 70mm의 비가 예상되고요,

 내일 전주의 아침 기온은 15도에서 출발하겠고요,

 한낮 기온은 22도까지 오르면서 평년 기온을 밑돌겠습니다.

id.title: [Cuaca] Hujan lebat 20~70mm di Jeonbuk hingga besok... Waspadai angin kencang, guntur, kilat, dan...
id.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8558070

Tidak seperti akhir pekan yang cerah, hujan turun di berbagai bagian Jeonbuk hari ini.

Hujan deras disertai angin kencang, guntur, dan kilat diperkirakan akan terjadi.

Hujan es mungkin turun di daerah-daerah dengan atmosfer yang tidak stabil.

Curah hujan 20 hingga 70 mm diperkirakan akan terjadi hingga besok,

dan mungkin ada daerah yang mengalami hujan deras terkonsentrasi sekitar 30 mm per jam.

Bersamaan dengan awan hujan, panas siang hari akan mereda.

Besok, suhu pagi di Jeonju akan dimulai dari 15 derajat,

dan suhu siang hari akan naik hingga 22 derajat, tetap di bawah suhu rata-rata untuk waktu ini dalam setahun.

Berikut prakiraan cuaca terperinci berdasarkan wilayah.

Besok, suhu pagi di Gunsan dan Gimje akan dimulai dari 15 derajat, dan suhu siang hari akan naik hingga 21 derajat.

Di wilayah timur, suhu akan dimulai dari 11 derajat di Muju dan 12 derajat di Imsil, naik hingga 20 derajat pada siang hari.

Besok, gelombang di lepas pantai Jeonbuk akan mencapai 1 meter, dan di Laut Barat bagian selatan, akan mencapai hingga 2 meter.

Setelah hujan berlalu besok, cuaca cerah akan berlanjut, dan

Suhu siang hari akan naik hingga sekitar 30 derajat selama akhir pekan.

Itulah laporan cuaca.

en-US.title: [Weather] Heavy rain of 20~70mm in Jeonbuk until tomorrow... Beware of gusts of wind, thunder, li...
en-US.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8558070

Unlike the clear weekend, rain is falling in various parts of Jeonbuk today.

Heavy rain accompanied by gusts of wind, thunder, and lightning is expected.

Hail may fall in areas where the atmosphere is unstable.

20 to 70 mm of rain is expected until tomorrow,

and there may be areas experiencing concentrated heavy rain of around 30 mm per hour.

Along with the rain clouds, the daytime heat will subside.

Tomorrow, the morning temperature in Jeonju will start at 15 degrees,

and the midday temperature will rise to 22 degrees, remaining below the average temperature for this time of year.

Here is the detailed weather forecast by region.

Tomorrow, the morning temperature in Gunsan and Gimje will start at 15 degrees, and the midday temperature will rise to 21 degrees.

In the eastern region, temperatures will start at 11 degrees in Muju and 12 degrees in Imsil, rising to 20 degrees by midday.

Tomorrow, waves off the coast of Jeonbuk will reach 1 meter, and in the southern West Sea, they will reach up to 2 meters.

After the rain passes tomorrow, clear weather will continue, and

Daytime temperatures will rise to around 30 degrees over the weekend.

That was the weather report.

snippet.title: 만 원으로 찾은 ‘새 보금자리’…남원 피움하우스 25가구 입주 / KBS  2026.05.11.
snippet.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8557982

[앵커]

 남원시의 피움하우스 3호점이 3대 1 경쟁률 속에 최종 입주자를 확정하고 기념식을 열었습니다.

 고창 청보리밭 축제가 23일 동안 50만 명 넘는 방문객을 끌어모으며 성황리에 막을 내렸습니다.

 전북의 지역 소식, 이종완 기자가 보도합니다.

 [리포트]  

남원시가  청년과 신혼부부의 주거 안정을 위해 마련한 ‘만원 임대주택’으로 불리는  피움하우스 3호점 최종 입주자 25가구를 확정하고, 기념행사를 열었습니다.

 '만원 임대주택'은  보증금 백만 원에, 월 임대료 만 원의 조건으로, 79가구가 신청해 3대 1의 경쟁률을 기록했습니다.

 기본 임대 기간은 2년이며, 자격을 유지하면 최대 6년까지 거주할 수 있습니다.

 [홍성봉/남원시 건축과장 : "청년과 신혼부부가 미래를 설계하고 주거와 삶의 질이 함께 높아질 수 있는 정책을 지속적으로 펼쳐 가겠습니다."]

 지난달 18일부터 주말까지 23일간 열린 '고창 청보리밭 축제'에 53만 4천여 명의 방문객이 다녀간 것으로 집계됐습니다.

 고창군은 지난 1일부터 5일까지 이어진 연휴 기간 가족 단위 관광객이 대거 몰렸고, 방문객이 낸 주차 요금을 고창사랑상품권으로 돌려주는 ‘주차 요금 전액 환급제’가 지역 상권 소비로 이어지며 지역경제 활성화에도 도움이 됐다고 밝혔습니다.

무주군이 무주읍 등 6개 읍·면 전역을 대상으로 ‘운문산 반딧불이’ 서식지와 출현 여부 조사에 나섭니다.

 지난해 출현이 확인된 35곳을 중심으로 7월 17일까지 예상 출현 지역까지 범위를 확대해 진행할 계획입니다.

 조사는 반딧불이 출현 시간대인 저녁 8시 30분부터 밤 10시 사이 현장을 확인하는 방식으로 이뤄집니다.

id.title: ‘Rumah Baru’ Ditemukan Seharga 10.000 Won… 25 Keluarga Pindah ke Namwon Pium House / KBS 2026.05.11.
id.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8557982

[Judul Berita]

Cabang Pium House No. 3 Kota Namwon mengkonfirmasi penyewa terakhirnya di tengah rasio persaingan 3:1 dan mengadakan upacara peringatan.

Festival Ladang Jelai Hijau Gochang berakhir dengan sukses besar, menarik lebih dari 500.000 pengunjung selama 23 hari.

Reporter Lee Jong-wan melaporkan berita lokal dari Jeonbuk.

[Laporan]

Kota Namwon mengkonfirmasi 25 rumah tangga terakhir untuk Cabang Pium House No. 3—yang dikenal sebagai "Perumahan Sewa 10.000 Won"—yang didirikan untuk memastikan stabilitas perumahan bagi kaum muda dan pengantin baru, dan mengadakan acara peringatan.

"Perumahan Sewa 10.000 Won" memiliki deposit 1 juta won dan sewa bulanan 10.000 won; Sebanyak 79 keluarga mengajukan permohonan, menghasilkan rasio persaingan 3:1.

Masa sewa dasar adalah dua tahun, dan penghuni dapat tinggal hingga enam tahun jika mereka mempertahankan kelayakan mereka.

[Hong Seong-bong / Kepala Divisi Arsitektur, Kota Namwon: "Kami akan terus menerapkan kebijakan yang memungkinkan kaum muda dan pasangan pengantin baru untuk merencanakan masa depan mereka dan meningkatkan perumahan serta kualitas hidup mereka."]

Telah tercatat bahwa sekitar 534.000 pengunjung menghadiri 'Festival Ladang Jelai Hijau Gochang,' yang diadakan selama 23 hari mulai tanggal 18 bulan lalu hingga akhir pekan.

Kabupaten Gochang menyatakan bahwa sejumlah besar wisatawan keluarga berbondong-bondong ke daerah tersebut selama periode liburan dari tanggal 1 hingga 5, dan bahwa 'Sistem Pengembalian Biaya Parkir Penuh,' yang mengembalikan biaya parkir pengunjung dalam bentuk Sertifikat Hadiah Cinta Gochang, berkontribusi pada revitalisasi ekonomi lokal dengan meningkatkan konsumsi di distrik komersial lokal.

Kabupaten Muju meluncurkan survei untuk mengidentifikasi habitat dan keberadaan 'Kunang-kunang Unmunsan' di seluruh enam kota dan kecamatannya, termasuk Muju-eup.

Rencananya adalah memperluas cakupan survei untuk mencakup area kemunculan yang diharapkan, dengan fokus pada 35 lokasi tempat kemunculan dikonfirmasi tahun lalu, dan melanjutkan investigasi hingga 17 Juli. Survei dilakukan dengan memverifikasi lokasi antara pukul 20.30 dan 22.00, waktu ketika kunang-kunang muncul.

Ini Lee Jong-wan untuk KBS News.

ko.title: 만 원으로 찾은 ‘새 보금자리’…남원 피움하우스 25가구 입주 / KBS  2026.05.11.
ko.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8557982

[앵커]

 남원시의 피움하우스 3호점이 3대 1 경쟁률 속에 최종 입주자를 확정하고 기념식을 열었습니다.

 고창 청보리밭 축제가 23일 동안 50만 명 넘는 방문객을 끌어모으며 성황리에 막을 내렸습니다.

 전북의 지역 소식, 이종완 기자가 보도합니다.

 [리포트]  

남원시가  청년과 신혼부부의 주거 안정을 위해 마련한 ‘만원 임대주택’으로 불리는  피움하우스 3호점 최종 입주자 25가구를 확정하고, 기념행사를 열었습니다.

 '만원 임대주택'은  보증금 백만 원에, 월 임대료 만 원의 조건으로, 79가구가 신청해 3대 1의 경쟁률을 기록했습니다.

 기본 임대 기간은 2년이며, 자격을 유지하면 최대 6년까지 거주할 수 있습니다.

 [홍성봉/남원시 건축과장 : "청년과 신혼부부가 미래를 설계하고 주거와 삶의 질이 함께 높아질 수 있는 정책을 지속적으로 펼쳐 가겠습니다."]

 지난달 18일부터 주말까지 23일간 열린 '고창 청보리밭 축제'에 53만 4천여 명의 방문객이 다녀간 것으로 집계됐습니다.

 고창군은 지난 1일부터 5일까지 이어진 연휴 기간 가족 단위 관광객이 대거 몰렸고, 방문객이 낸 주차 요금을 고창사랑상품권으로 돌려주는 ‘주차 요금 전액 환급제’가 지역 상권 소비로 이어지며 지역경제 활성화에도 도움이 됐다고 밝혔습니다.

무주군이 무주읍 등 6개 읍·면 전역을 대상으로 ‘운문산 반딧불이’ 서식지와 출현 여부 조사에 나섭니다.

 지난해 출현이 확인된 35곳을 중심으로 7월 17일까지 예상 출현 지역까지 범위를 확대해 진행할 계획입니다.

 조사는 반딧불이 출현 시간대인 저녁 8시 30분부터 밤 10시 사이 현장을 확인하는 방식으로 이뤄집니다.

en-US.title: ‘New Home’ Found for 10,000 Won… 25 Households Move into Namwon Pium House / KBS May 11, 2026
en-US.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8557982

[Anchor]

Namwon City’s Pium House Branch No. 3 confirmed its final tenants amidst a 3:1 competition ratio and held a commemorative ceremony.

The Gochang Green Barley Field Festival concluded with great success, attracting over 500,000 visitors over 23 days.

Reporter Lee Jong-wan reports on local news from Jeonbuk.

[Report]

Namwon City confirmed the final 25 households for Pium House Branch No. 3—known as the "10,000 Won Rental Housing"—established to ensure housing stability for young people and newlyweds, and held a commemorative event.

The "10,000 Won Rental Housing" features a deposit of 1 million won and a monthly rent of 10,000 won; 79 households applied, resulting in a 3:1 competition ratio.

The basic lease period is two years, and residents can stay for up to six years if they maintain their eligibility.

[Hong Seong-bong / Head of Architecture Division, Namwon City: "We will continue to implement policies that allow young people and newlyweds to plan their futures and improve both their housing and quality of life."]

It has been tallied that approximately 534,000 visitors attended the 'Gochang Green Barley Field Festival,' which was held for 23 days from the 18th of last month through the weekend.

Gochang County stated that a large number of family tourists flocked to the area during the holiday period from the 1st to the 5th, and that the 'Full Parking Fee Refund System,' which returns visitors' parking fees in the form of Gochang Love Gift Certificates, contributed to revitalizing the local economy by boosting consumption in local commercial districts.

Muju County is launching a survey to identify habitats and the presence of 'Unmunsan Fireflies' across all six of its towns and townships, including Muju-eup.

The plan is to expand the scope of the survey to include expected appearance areas, focusing on the 35 locations where appearances were confirmed last year, and continue the investigation until July 17. The survey is conducted by verifying the site between 8:30 PM and 10:00 PM, the time when fireflies appear.

This is Lee Jong-wan for KBS News.

snippet.title: 지역 농협 위탁 판매…정산금 ‘논란’ / KBS  2026.05.11.
snippet.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8557974

[앵커] 

지역 농협이 판매를 대행한 '배' 정산금을 두고  농민들이 피해를 호소하고 있습니다.

 하지만 해당 농협은 이해할 수 없다는 반응인데요.

 어떤 사연인지, 안태성 기자가 취재했습니다.

 [리포트] 

전주에서 배를 키우는  최정호 씨.

 지난 1월 중순,  저온 창고에 보관해 놓은  18kg짜리 배 상자 2천6백여 개를 한 지역 농협에 보냈습니다.

 위탁 판매 방식으로, 농협이 선별과 포장을 거쳐 대형마트 등에 납품하는 구조인데, 최 씨는 두 달 뒤  통장에 찍힌 정산금을 보고  깜짝 놀랐습니다.

 예상했던 액수보다  반 이상 줄었기 때문입니다.

 품질이 떨어지는 배들이 많아 제값을 쳐주기 어렵다는 농협 측 설명을 들었다는데, 이미 배를 처분한 뒤여서 확인조차 할 수 없었습니다.

 [최정호/배 재배 농민 : "담당자한테 이 배를 시장에 출하했으면 얼마 정도 나오겠냐 (물어보니까), 6∼7만 원 거뜬히 나와요. 그런데 2만 8천밖에 안 나와요. 담당자도 인정한 배를. 그럼, 왜 이렇게 싸게 나왔는가 내가 억울해서..."]

 근처 또 다른 농가도  같은 피해를 호소합니다.

 다른 농협에선 한 상자에 4만 원 정도 쳐주던걸  해당 농협에선 2만 원으로 산정해  큰 손실을 봤다는 겁니다.

 [배 재배 농민/음성변조 : "반토막 날 정도로 많이 썩지는 않았을 거란 말이에요. 근데 썩었다고 입금을 조금밖에 안 하니까. 수입이 전혀 없는 거죠."]

 해당 농협은 관리나 정산 과정에 문제가 없다는 입장.

 농민들이 출하한 배를 곧바로 등급별로 선별한 뒤 결과를 문자로 통보했다며, 당시 문자를 보고  이의를 제기하거나 배를 다시 가져가겠다는 농민은 없었다고 말했습니다.

 정산금이 줄어든 건 품질이 떨어진 배들이 많았기 때문이라고  설명했습니다.

 [○○농협 관계자 : "전반적으로 (품질이 떨어진) 가공이나 알뜰배 비율이 높아진 건 사실입니다. 비품율이 높아진 부문은 저희가 보관상의 문제나 이런 것은 없고..."]

 농가 다섯 곳이 피해를 봤다는 관련 내용이 국민신문고에도 접수돼 농협중앙회 전북본부가 사실 관계를  조사하고 있습니다.

 KBS 뉴스 안태성입니다.

 촬영기자:이주노·김동균

en-US.title: Consignment sales by local agricultural cooperatives… Settlement ‘controversy’ / KBS 2026.05.11.
en-US.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8557974

[Anchor]

Farmers are complaining about damages regarding the settlement payments for pears sold on behalf of a local agricultural cooperative.

However, the cooperative in question is responding with incomprehension.

Reporter Ahn Tae-seong investigated the story behind this.

[Report]

Choi Jeong-ho, who grows pears in Jeonju.

In mid-January, he sent approximately 2,600 boxes of 18kg pears, which he had stored in a cold storage facility, to a local agricultural cooperative.

This is a consignment sales method where the cooperative sorts and packages the pears before supplying them to large supermarkets and other outlets. However, Mr. Choi was shocked when he saw the settlement amount deposited into his account two months later.

This was because the amount was more than half less than he had expected.

He said he was told by the cooperative that it was difficult to pay a fair price because there were many pears of poor quality, but since he had already disposed of the pears, he was unable to even verify the explanation.

[Choi Jeong-ho / Pear Farmer: "I asked the person in charge how much these pears would fetch if I shipped them to the market, and they said it would easily be 60,000 to 70,000 won. But it only came out to 28,000 won. Even the person in charge acknowledged that these were pears. So, I feel wronged wondering why they were priced so low..."]

Another nearby farmer is complaining of the same damage.

They say they suffered a significant loss because the cooperative in question valued them at only 20,000 won, whereas other agricultural cooperatives would have paid around 40,000 won per box.

[Pear Farmer / Voice altered: "They wouldn't have rotted enough to be cut in half. But because they claim they were rotten and only deposit a small amount, there is absolutely no income."]

The cooperative in question maintains that there were no issues with the management or settlement process.

They stated that they immediately sorted the pears shipped by farmers by grade and notified the results via text message, adding that at the time, no farmers raised objections or tried to take the pears back after seeing the text.

**Choi Jeong-ho / Pear Farmer:** They explained that the decrease in settlement payments was due to a large number of pears of lower quality.

[○○ Agricultural Cooperative Official: "It is true that the proportion of processed or budget pears (of lower quality) has increased overall. Regarding the increase in the rate of defective products, we do not have any storage issues or anything like that..."]

Related reports claiming that five farms suffered damages have also been filed with the National Petition System, and the Jeonbuk Regional Headquarters of the National Agricultural Cooperative Federation is currently investigating the facts.

This is Ahn Tae-seong from KBS News.

Cameramen: Lee Ju-no, Kim Dong-gyun

 농민들이 출하한 배를 곧바로 등급별로 선별한 뒤 결과를 문자로 통보했다며, 당시 문자를 보고  이의를 제기하거나 배를 다시 가져가겠다는 농민은 없었다고 말했습니다.

 정산금이 줄어든 건 품질이 떨어진 배들이 많았기 때문이라고  설명했습니다.

 [○○농협 관계자 : "전반적으로 (품질이 떨어진) 가공이나 알뜰배 비율이 높아진 건 사실입니다. 비품율이 높아진 부문은 저희가 보관상의 문제나 이런 것은 없고..."]

 농가 다섯 곳이 피해를 봤다는 관련 내용이 국민신문고에도 접수돼 농협중앙회 전북본부가 사실 관계를  조사하고 있습니다.

id.title: Penjualan konsinyasi oleh koperasi pertanian lokal… ‘Kontroversi’ penyelesaian / KBS 2026.05.11.
id.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8557974

[Pembawa Acara]

Para petani mengeluhkan kerugian terkait pembayaran ganti rugi atas buah pir yang dijual atas nama koperasi pertanian setempat.

Namun, koperasi yang bersangkutan menanggapi dengan ketidakpahaman.

Reporter Ahn Tae-seong menyelidiki kisah di balik ini.

[Laporan]

Choi Jeong-ho, petani pir di Jeonju.

Pada pertengahan Januari, ia mengirimkan sekitar 2.600 kotak berisi 18 kg buah pir, yang telah disimpannya di fasilitas penyimpanan dingin, ke koperasi pertanian setempat.

Ini adalah metode penjualan konsinyasi di mana koperasi memilah dan mengemas buah pir sebelum memasoknya ke supermarket besar dan gerai lainnya. Namun, Bapak Choi terkejut ketika melihat jumlah ganti rugi yang masuk ke rekeningnya dua bulan kemudian.

Hal ini karena jumlahnya lebih dari setengah lebih kecil dari yang ia harapkan.

Ia mengatakan bahwa ia diberitahu oleh koperasi bahwa sulit untuk membayar harga yang adil karena banyak buah pir berkualitas buruk, tetapi karena ia sudah membuang buah pir tersebut, ia bahkan tidak dapat memverifikasi penjelasan tersebut.

[Choi Jeong-ho / Petani Pir: "Saya bertanya kepada penanggung jawab berapa harga yang akan didapatkan jika saya mengirimkan buah pir ini ke pasar, dan mereka mengatakan harganya akan mencapai 60.000 hingga 70.000 won. Tetapi ternyata hanya 28.000 won. Bahkan penanggung jawab pun mengakui bahwa ini adalah buah pir. Jadi, saya merasa dirugikan dan bertanya-tanya mengapa harganya begitu rendah..."]

Petani lain di dekatnya mengeluhkan kerugian yang sama.

Mereka mengatakan bahwa mereka mengalami kerugian yang signifikan karena koperasi tersebut hanya menilai buah pir mereka seharga 20.000 won, sedangkan koperasi pertanian lain akan membayar sekitar 40.000 won per kotak.

[Petani Pir / Suara diubah: "Buah pir itu tidak akan membusuk sampai harus dipotong menjadi dua. Tetapi karena mereka mengklaim buah pir itu busuk dan hanya menyetorkan sejumlah kecil uang, sama sekali tidak ada pendapatan."]

Koperasi yang bersangkutan menyatakan bahwa tidak ada masalah dengan manajemen atau proses penyelesaian.

Mereka menyatakan bahwa mereka segera memilah buah pir yang dikirim oleh petani berdasarkan kualitas dan memberitahukan hasilnya melalui pesan teks, menambahkan bahwa pada saat itu, tidak ada petani yang mengajukan keberatan atau mencoba mengambil kembali buah pir setelah melihat pesan teks tersebut.

**Choi Jeong-ho / Petani Pir:** Mereka menjelaskan bahwa penurunan pembayaran penyelesaian disebabkan oleh banyaknya buah pir berkualitas rendah.


[○○ Pejabat Koperasi Pertanian: "Memang benar bahwa proporsi pir olahan atau pir murah (berkualitas rendah) secara keseluruhan telah meningkat. Mengenai peningkatan tingkat produk cacat, kami tidak memiliki masalah penyimpanan atau hal semacam itu..."]

Laporan terkait yang mengklaim bahwa lima pertanian mengalami kerugian juga telah diajukan ke Sistem Petisi Nasional, dan Kantor Pusat Regional Jeonbuk dari Federasi Koperasi Pertanian Nasional saat ini sedang menyelidiki fakta-fakta tersebut.

Ini adalah Ahn Tae-seong dari KBS News.

snippet.title: [이슈K] 전북 흔드는 사법리스크…김관영 무소속 출마 파장은? / KBS  2026.05.11.
snippet.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8557943

[앵커]

 이슈 K 시간입니다.

 더불어민주당에서 제명된 김관영 전북도지사가 무소속 출마를 선언하며 전북 정치권이 요동치고 있습니다.

 또, 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 재보궐 선거에 민주당이 전략공천을 마무리 지었는데요,

 한 주간의 정가 소식, 오늘은 홍민호 변호사와 함께 짚어봅니다.

 어서 오십시오.

 현금 제공 의혹으로 민주당에서 제명된 김관영 지사가 무소속으로 재선에 도전합니다.

 특검에서 내란 동조 혐의를 벗긴 했지만 현금 제공 의혹은 기소 가능성이 높다고 알려졌거든요.

 김 지사의 사법 리스크가 큰 상황에서 전북도지사 선거구도, 어떻게 전개되리라 보십니까?

 [앵커]

 한편, '밥값 대납 의혹'을 받는  이원택 민주당 전북도지사 후보도 경찰 조사받았죠.

 이 후보는 대납 지시 등을 하지 않았다며 혐의를 강하게 부인했는데요.

 선거에 어떤 영향을 미칠까요?

 [앵커]

 그런가 하면 민주당이 지방선거와 함께 재보선이 치러지는 군산·김제·부안 갑과 을 선거구에 각각 김의겸 전 새만금개발청장과 박지원 최고위원을 전략공천했습니다.

 특히 군산·김제·부안 을 선거구엔 물망에 오른 분들이 많았거든요. 

예상했던 결과일까요, 어떻게 보십니까?

 [앵커]

 교육감 선거도 짚어보죠. 

유성동 예비후보가 천호성 예비후보로 단일화하기로 하면서 교육감 선거가 2파전으로 압축됐습니다.

 하지만, 단일화 과정에서 '고위직 거래 의혹'이 담긴 녹취가 공개돼 논란이 되고 있는데요.

 어떻게 보십니까?

 [앵커]

 마지막으로 민주당 전북도당이 광역의원 후보 공천도 마무리했는데요,

 이 가운데 관심 있는 선거구, 어디일까요?

 [앵커]

 네, 여기까지 듣겠습니다.

 오늘 말씀, 감사합니다.

 영상편집:한동엽/글·구성:이은선

id.title: [Edisi K] Risiko Peradilan Mengguncang Jeonbuk… Apa Dampak dari Pencalonan Independen Kim Kwan-yo...
id.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8557943

[Pembawa Acara]

Ini adalah Edisi K.

Situasi politik di Jeonbuk sedang bergejolak karena Gubernur Jeonbuk Kim Kwan-young, yang dipecat dari Partai Demokrat, telah menyatakan pencalonannya sebagai independen.

Selain itu, Partai Demokrat telah menyelesaikan nominasi strategisnya untuk pemilihan sela yang diadakan bersamaan dengan pemilihan lokal.

Hari ini, kita akan mengulas berita politik minggu ini bersama Pengacara Hong Min-ho.

Selamat datang.

Gubernur Kim Kwan-young, yang dipecat dari Partai Demokrat atas tuduhan memberikan uang tunai, mencalonkan diri kembali sebagai independen.

Meskipun ia dibebaskan dari tuduhan keterlibatan dalam pemberontakan oleh jaksa khusus, dilaporkan bahwa ada kemungkinan besar ia akan didakwa terkait tuduhan pemberian uang tunai tersebut.

Mengingat risiko hukum yang signifikan yang dihadapi Gubernur Kim, bagaimana Anda memperkirakan jalannya pemilihan gubernur Jeonbuk?

[Pembawa Acara]

Sementara itu, Lee Won-taek, kandidat Partai Demokrat untuk Gubernur Provinsi Jeolla Utara yang dicurigai membayar makanan atas nama orang lain, juga diinterogasi oleh polisi.

Kandidat Lee dengan tegas membantah tuduhan tersebut, menyatakan bahwa ia tidak memberikan instruksi apa pun untuk membayar makanan atas nama orang lain.

Bagaimana hal ini akan memengaruhi pemilihan?

[Pembawa Acara]

Sementara itu, Partai Demokrat secara strategis mencalonkan Kim Eui-kyum, mantan kepala Otoritas Pengembangan Saemangeum, dan Park Ji-won, anggota Dewan Tertinggi, masing-masing untuk daerah pemilihan Gunsan-Gimje-Buan A dan B, di mana pemilihan sela diadakan bersamaan dengan pemilihan lokal.

Secara khusus, ada banyak kandidat yang dipertimbangkan untuk daerah pemilihan Gunsan-Gimje-Buan B.

Apakah ini hasil yang diharapkan? Bagaimana pendapat Anda?

[Pembawa Acara]

Mari kita lihat juga pemilihan Kepala Dinas Pendidikan.

Persaingan telah menyempit menjadi dua kubu karena calon sementara Yoo Seong-dong memutuskan untuk bersatu di belakang calon sementara Cheon Ho-seong.

Namun, sebuah rekaman yang berisi tuduhan "berurusan dengan pejabat tinggi" selama proses penyatuan telah dirilis, memicu kontroversi.

Bagaimana pendapat Anda?

[Pembawa Acara]

[Anchor]

This is Issue K.

The political scene in Jeonbuk is in turmoil as Jeonbuk Governor Kim Kwan-young, who was expelled from the Democratic Party, has declared his candidacy as an independent.

Additionally, the Democratic Party has finalized its strategic nominations for the by-elections being held concurrently with the local elections.

Today, we will review the week's political news with Attorney Hong Min-ho.

Welcome.

Governor Kim Kwan-young, who was expelled from the Democratic Party over allegations of providing cash, is running for re-election as an independent.

Although he was cleared of charges of complicity in insurrection by the special prosecutor, it is reported that there is a high possibility of indictment regarding the cash provision allegations.

Given the significant legal risks facing Governor Kim, how do you foresee the landscape of the Jeonbuk gubernatorial election unfolding?

How will this affect the election?

What are your thoughts?

Among these, which constituencies are of particular interest?

snippet.title: 시장 경선 탈락하자 지방의원 출마…“정치 기회주의” / KBS  2026.05.11.
snippet.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8557909

[앵커]

 더불어민주당 군산시장 경선에 참여했다가 탈락한 후보들이  줄줄이 시·도의원 선거에 출마하고 있습니다.

 선거구 획정으로 늘어난 자리를 노린 건데, 기회주의적이라는 비판의 목소리가 높습니다.

 김현주 기자가 보도합니다.

 [리포트]

 더불어민주당 군산시장 경선에서  김재준 후보에 밀려  결선에서 탈락한 김영일 군산시의원.

 김 의원이 경선 과정에서 후원회 사무소로 쓰던 건물에는 현수막이 그대로 걸려있습니다.

 그런데 '시장 후보'라는 글자만 가리고  '시의원'으로  새 천을 덧대놨습니다.

 군산시의회 의장까지 지낸 김 의원은  시장 경선 결과에 불복해  재심까지 신청하고도, 다시 시의원 출마를 위해  예비후보 등록을 마쳤습니다.

 해당 선거구는 의원 정수가 2명에서 3명으로 늘어난 곳, 새로 생긴 자리에 눈을 돌린 겁니다.

 광역의원 선거도 마찬가지입니다.

 군산시장 경선에서 탈락한 후보들이 군산시 제3선거구에 잇따라 출사표를 냈습니다.

 나종대 군산시의원과 박정희 전 전북도의원이 경선에 참여해 나종대 시의원이 공천을 받았습니다.

 민주당 군산시장 후보 경선에  참여했다가 떨어진 7명 가운데 3명이  자리만 바꿔서  다시 선거에 나온 겁니다.

 지역 발전이 아닌, 자기 권력을 유지하기 위한 기회주의적 선택이라는 비판이 나옵니다.

 나아가 이러한 행태를  알면서도 걸러내지 못하는  민주당 공천 방식도  문제가 있다는 지적입니다.

 [유재임/참여자치군산시민연대 사무국장 : "시장은 행정가잖아요. 지방행정을 어떻게 이끌어가겠다고 하는 사람이 갑자기 그걸 감시하는 의원 자리로 가는 거예요. 그럼, 이 사람이 실제로 시장을 하고 싶은 마음이 있었던 건지 의구심이 드는 거죠."]

 떨어지더라도  자리만 바꿔 다시 선거에 뛰어드는  '회전문 출마', 지역 정치에 대한 유권자 피로감만 키우고 있습니다.  

KBS 뉴스 김현주입니다.

id.title: Gagal di pemilihan walikota, malah maju jadi anggota dewan daerah... "Oportunisme politik" / KBS ...
id.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8557909

[Judul Berita]

Para kandidat yang berpartisipasi dalam pemilihan pendahuluan Partai Demokrat Korea untuk Walikota Gunsan tetapi tersingkir, kini berlomba-lomba dalam pemilihan dewan kota dan provinsi.

Mereka mengincar kursi yang tercipta akibat penataan ulang daerah pemilihan, tetapi kritik yang menyebut hal ini sebagai oportunisme semakin meningkat.

Laporan oleh Reporter Kim Hyun-ju.

[Laporan]

Anggota Dewan Kota Gunsan, Kim Young-il, yang tersingkir dalam putaran kedua setelah kalah dari kandidat Kim Jae-jun dalam pemilihan pendahuluan Partai Demokrat Korea untuk Walikota Gunsan.

Spanduk tersebut masih tergantung di gedung yang digunakan anggota Dewan Kim sebagai kantor kampanyenya selama proses pemilihan pendahuluan.

Namun, ia telah menutupi tulisan "Calon Walikota" dan menggantinya dengan kain baru bertuliskan "Anggota Dewan Kota."

Anggota Dewan Kim, yang bahkan pernah menjabat sebagai Ketua Dewan Kota Gunsan, telah menyelesaikan pendaftaran calon sementara untuk kembali mencalonkan diri sebagai anggota dewan kota, meskipun telah mengajukan banding atas hasil pemilihan pendahuluan walikota dan meminta pemeriksaan ulang. Mereka telah mengalihkan perhatian mereka ke kursi-kursi baru yang dibentuk di daerah pemilihan di mana jumlah anggota dewan ditingkatkan dari dua menjadi tiga.

Hal yang sama berlaku untuk pemilihan dewan provinsi.

Para kandidat yang tersingkir dalam pemilihan pendahuluan walikota Gunsan secara berturut-turut telah menyatakan pencalonan mereka untuk daerah pemilihan ke-3 Kota Gunsan.

Anggota Dewan Kota Gunsan Na Jong-dae dan mantan anggota Majelis Provinsi Jeonbuk Park Jung-hee berpartisipasi dalam pemilihan pendahuluan, dan anggota Dewan Kota Na Jong-dae menerima nominasi.

Dari tujuh kandidat yang berpartisipasi dalam pemilihan pendahuluan walikota Gunsan dari Partai Demokrat dan tersingkir, tiga di antaranya hanya berpindah kursi untuk kembali mencalonkan diri dalam pemilihan.

Kritik semakin meningkat bahwa ini adalah pilihan oportunistik yang bertujuan untuk mempertahankan kekuasaan mereka sendiri daripada mempromosikan pembangunan regional.

Lebih lanjut, ditekankan bahwa proses nominasi Partai Demokrat juga bermasalah, karena gagal menyaring perilaku semacam itu meskipun menyadarinya. [Yoo Jae-im / Sekretaris Jenderal, Solidaritas Warga Gunsan untuk Pemerintahan Mandiri Partisipatif: "Walikota pada akhirnya adalah seorang administrator. Seseorang yang mengklaim akan memimpin pemerintahan lokal tiba-tiba pindah ke kursi dewan yang dimaksudkan untuk mengawasinya. Ini menimbulkan keraguan tentang apakah mereka benar-benar memiliki keinginan untuk menjadi walikota."]

"Pencalonan pintu putar," di mana kandidat kembali ke pemilihan hanya dengan mengubah posisi bahkan setelah kalah, hanya memicu kelelahan pemilih terhadap politik lokal.

Ini Kim Hyun-ju untuk KBS News.

Juru Kamera: Jung Sung-soo

en-US.title: Runs for local council after losing mayoral primary… “Political opportunism” / KBS May 11, 2026
en-US.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8557909

[Anchor]

Candidates who participated in the Democratic Party of Korea's primary for Gunsan Mayor but were eliminated are running one after another in city and provincial council elections.

They are aiming for the seats created by redistricting, but there are growing voices of criticism calling this opportunism.

Reporter Kim Hyun-ju reports.

[Report]

Gunsan City Council member Kim Young-il, who was eliminated in the runoff after losing to candidate Kim Jae-jun in the Democratic Party of Korea's primary for Gunsan Mayor.

The banner remains hanging on the building that Council member Kim used as his campaign office during the primary process.

However, he has covered up the words "Mayoral Candidate" and covered it with a new cloth reading "City Council Member."

Council member Kim, who even served as the Chairman of the Gunsan City Council, has completed his preliminary candidate registration to run for city council again, even after appealing the results of the mayoral primary and requesting a re-examination. They have turned their attention to the newly created seats in the electoral district where the number of council members was increased from two to three.

The same applies to the provincial council elections.

Candidates who were eliminated in the Gunsan mayoral primary have successively declared their candidacy for Gunsan City's 3rd electoral district.

Gunsan City Council member Na Jong-dae and former Jeonbuk Provincial Assembly member Park Jung-hee participated in the primary, and City Council member Na Jong-dae received the nomination.

Of the seven candidates who participated in the Democratic Party's Gunsan mayoral primary and were eliminated, three have simply switched seats to run again in the election.

Criticism is mounting that this is an opportunistic choice aimed at maintaining their own power rather than promoting regional development.

Furthermore, it is pointed out that the Democratic Party's nomination process is also problematic, as it fails to filter out such behavior despite being aware of it. [Yoo Jae-im / Secretary General, Participatory Self-Government Gunsan Citizens' Solidarity: "The mayor is an administrator, after all. Someone who claims they will lead local administration suddenly moves to a council seat meant to oversee it. This raises doubts about whether they actually had any desire to be mayor."]

"Revolving door candidacy," where candidates jump back into elections simply by changing positions even after losing, is only fueling voter fatigue regarding local politics.

This is Kim Hyun-ju for KBS News.

Cameraman: Jung Sung-soo

snippet.title: 전북서 단체장 3명 공천 국민의힘…유권자 설득 방안은? / KBS  2026.05.11.
snippet.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8557901

[앵커]

 12·3 비상계엄 뒤 치러지는 이번 지방선거에서 국민의힘은 어느 때보다 전북에서 힘든 선거전이 예상되는데요.

 인물난 속에  단체장 후보 3명을 공천했지만,  유권자를 어떻게 설득할지도 관건입니다.

 진유민 기자가 보도합니다.

 [리포트]

 재공모를 거쳐 국민의힘 전북도지사 후보로 단수 공천된 양정무 예비후보.

 국민의힘 광역단체장 후보 가운데 가장 많은 9건의 전과 기록과 윤석열 전 대통령  탄핵 반대 집회 과정서 불거진 욕설 논란, '내란 가담 혐의'를 받는 한덕수 전 총리 대통령 추대 발언 등이 전북도지사 후보로서 적절하냐는 지역 여론이 잇따랐습니다.

 [박덕흠/국민의힘 공천관리위원장/지난달 22일 : "그런 부분이 결격 사유가 없다는 그런 판단들을 했다는 말씀을 드립니다."]

 우여곡절 끝에 국민의힘 전북도지사 후보로 나선 양정무 예비후보.

 기업 유치와  청년이 머무는 전북을 만들겠다며, 첫 공약으로  모든 도민에게 '긴급생활 민생지원금' 2백만 원 지급을 약속했습니다.

 전북의 낙후 원인으로 견제 없는 민주당 독점 구도를 꼽으며, 민주당 이원택, 무소속 김관영 예비후보의  사법 리스크를 지적했습니다.

 [양정무/국민의힘 전북도지사 예비후보 : "두 분 다 선거법에 (위반 혐의로) 이미 조사를 받는 부분들이 있지 않습니까. 그래서 저는 우리 도민들에게 호소하고 싶은 것은 다시 재선거를 통해서 전북의 재정이 낭비되지 않길 바란다는..."]

 근로기준법 위반 등 9건의 전과에 대해선 과거 기업을 운영하며  경영난 속 불가피한 일이었다며 밀린 급여는 늦게라도 지급했다고 해명했습니다.

 전북도지사 외에 전주시장 선거에 조양덕 예원예술대 객원교수를 부안군수에는 김성태 예비후보를 공천하며 단체장 후보 3명에 그친 국민의힘.

 인물난과 후보자 자격 논란 속 등 돌린 지역 민심을 얼마나  회복할 수 있을지가 최대 과제로 떠오르고 있습니다.

id.title: Partai Kekuatan Rakyat Menominasikan 3 Kepala Pemerintahan Daerah di Jeonbuk… Bagaimana Cara Memb...
id.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8557901

[Pembawa Acara]

Dalam pemilihan lokal ini, yang diadakan setelah deklarasi darurat militer pada 3 Desember, Partai Kekuatan Rakyat diperkirakan akan menghadapi pertempuran pemilihan yang lebih sulit di Jeonbuk daripada sebelumnya.

Meskipun mereka telah mencalonkan tiga kandidat untuk kepala pemerintahan daerah di tengah kekurangan kandidat yang sesuai, bagaimana mereka akan meyakinkan pemilih tetap menjadi faktor kunci.

Laporan oleh Reporter Jin Yu-min.

[Laporan]

Yang Jeong-mu, kandidat sementara yang dinominasikan sebagai satu-satunya kandidat Partai Kekuatan Rakyat untuk Gubernur Jeonbuk setelah proses pengajuan ulang.

Opini publik setempat berulang kali mempertanyakan kelayakannya sebagai calon Gubernur Jeonbuk karena catatan kriminalnya yang terdiri dari sembilan hukuman—tertinggi di antara calon Partai Kekuatan Rakyat untuk kepala metropolitan dan provinsi—serta kontroversi mengenai kata-kata kasar yang muncul selama demonstrasi menentang pemakzulan mantan Presiden Yoon Suk-yeol, dan pernyataannya yang menyerukan pencalonan mantan Perdana Menteri Han Duck-soo, yang menghadapi tuduhan "keterlibatan dalam pemberontakan."

[Park Deok-heum / Ketua Komite Manajemen Nominasi Partai Kekuatan Rakyat / 22 bulan lalu: "Saya ingin menyatakan bahwa kami telah menetapkan bahwa tidak ada alasan untuk diskualifikasi terkait hal-hal tersebut."]

Yang Jeong-mu, calon sementara yang telah maju sebagai calon Partai Kekuatan Rakyat untuk Gubernur Provinsi Jeonbuk setelah banyak lika-liku.

Berjanji untuk menarik bisnis dan menciptakan Jeonbuk yang menjadi tempat tinggal kaum muda, ia berjanji untuk menyediakan 2 juta won dalam "Dana Dukungan Penghidupan Darurat" kepada setiap penduduk sebagai janji kampanye pertamanya.

Mengutip monopoli Partai Demokrat yang tak terkendali sebagai penyebab keterbelakangan Jeonbuk, ia menunjuk risiko hukum yang terkait dengan calon pendahuluan Lee Won-taek dari Partai Demokrat dan Kim Kwan-young, seorang independen. [Yang Jeong-mu / Calon Pendahuluan Partai Kekuatan Rakyat untuk Gubernur Jeolla Utara: "Kalian berdua sudah diselidiki karena pelanggaran undang-undang pemilu, bukan? Oleh karena itu, yang ingin saya sampaikan kepada penduduk provinsi kita adalah semoga keuangan Jeolla Utara tidak terbuang sia-sia melalui pemilihan ulang..."]

Mengenai sembilan hukuman sebelumnya, termasuk pelanggaran Undang-Undang Standar Ketenagakerjaan, ia menjelaskan bahwa hal itu tidak dapat dihindari karena kesulitan manajemen saat menjalankan bisnis di masa lalu, dan bahwa ia telah membayar upah yang tertunggak, meskipun terlambat.

Selain pemilihan Gubernur Jeolla Utara, Partai Kekuatan Rakyat mencalonkan Jo Yang-deok, seorang profesor tamu di Universitas Seni Yewon, untuk pemilihan Walikota Jeonju, dan Kim Seong-tae, calon sementara untuk pemilihan Gubernur Kabupaten Buan, sehingga hanya ada tiga kandidat untuk kepala pemerintahan daerah.

Tantangan terbesar bagi partai ini adalah seberapa besar mereka dapat memulihkan sentimen publik lokal yang telah berpaling dari mereka di tengah kekurangan kandidat yang sesuai dan kontroversi mengenai kualifikasi kandidat.

Ini adalah laporan Jin Yu-min untuk KBS News.

Juru Kamera: Shin Jae-bok

en-US.title: People Power Party Nominates 3 Local Government Heads in Jeonbuk… How to Persuade Voters? / KBS M...
en-US.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8557901

[Anchor]

In this local election, held following the December 3rd declaration of martial law, the People Power Party is expected to face a tougher election battle in Jeonbuk than ever before.

Although they have nominated three candidates for local government heads amidst a shortage of suitable candidates, how they will persuade voters remains a key factor.

Reporter Jin Yu-min reports.

[Report]

Yang Jeong-mu, the preliminary candidate who was nominated as the sole candidate for the People Power Party's Jeonbuk Governor after a re-application process.

Local public opinion has repeatedly questioned his suitability as a candidate for Jeonbuk Governor due to his criminal record of nine convictions—the highest among the People Power Party's candidates for metropolitan and provincial heads—as well as the controversy over profanity that emerged during a rally opposing the impeachment of former President Yoon Suk-yeol, and his remarks calling for the presidency of former Prime Minister Han Duck-soo, who is facing charges of "involvement in insurrection."

[Park Deok-heum / Chairman of the People Power Party Nomination Management Committee / 22nd of last month: "I would like to state that we have determined that there are no grounds for disqualification regarding those matters."]

Yang Jeong-mu, a preliminary candidate who has stepped forward as the People Power Party's nominee for Governor of Jeonbuk Province after many twists and turns.

Promising to attract businesses and create a Jeonbuk where young people stay, he pledged to provide 2 million won in "Emergency Livelihood Support Funds" to every resident as his first campaign promise.

Citing the unchecked monopoly of the Democratic Party as the cause of Jeonbuk's underdevelopment, he pointed out the legal risks associated with preliminary candidates Lee Won-taek of the Democratic Party and Kim Kwan-young, an independent. [Yang Jeong-mu / People Power Party Preliminary Candidate for North Jeolla Governor: "Both of you are already under investigation for violations of election laws, aren't you? Therefore, what I want to appeal to the residents of our province is that we hope the finances of North Jeolla will not be wasted through a re-election..."]

Regarding his nine prior convictions, including violations of the Labor Standards Act, he explained that they were unavoidable due to management difficulties while operating a business in the past, and that he paid overdue wages, even if belatedly.

Aside from the North Jeolla Governor election, the People Power Party nominated Jo Yang-deok, a visiting professor at Yewon Arts University, for the Jeonju Mayoral election, and Kim Seong-tae, a preliminary candidate for the Buan County Governor election, resulting in only three candidates for local government heads.

The biggest challenge for the party is how much it can recover the local public sentiment that has turned its back on it amidst a shortage of suitable candidates and controversies over candidate qualifications.

This is Jin Yu-min reporting for KBS News.

Cameraman: Shin Jae-bok

snippet.title: 한병도 원내대표, 이원택은 지원사격-김관영엔 맹공 / KBS  2026.05.11.
snippet.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8557893

[앵커]

 최근 연임에 성공한 한병도 민주당 원내대표가 전북을 찾아, 이원택 전북지사 후보 지지를 호소했습니다.

 반면 무소속 출마 이후 민주당 지도부와 공방을 이어가는 김관영 지사에 대해서는, 제명 조치에 문제가 없었다며 강하게 비판했습니다.

 조경모 기자입니다.

 [리포트]

 현금 살포 의혹 등으로 민주당에서 제명된 뒤 무소속 출마를 선언한 김관영 지사.

 자신을 민주당의 불공정 공천 피해자라고 주장하며, 선거 승리 뒤 복당 의사도 밝혔습니다.

 [김관영/무소속 전북지사 예비후보/지난 7일 : "제가 진짜 민주당 후보라고 생각합니다. 선거 마치고 승리해서 민주당의 공정과 정의를 회복하는 상징적인 사건을 만들고, 민주당에 복당하겠습니다."]

 민주당 지도부는 강하게 반발했습니다.

 조승래 사무총장은 김 지사의 무소속 출마는 공천 불복이자 중대한 해당 행위라며, 복당이 불가능하다고 못박았습니다.

 [조승래/민주당 사무총장/어제 : "이건 당연히 공천 불복에 해당할 뿐만 아니라 중대, 중대한 해당 행위이기 때문에 당헌 당규에 의해서 영원히 복당이 불가능하다는 점을 분명히 말씀드리겠습니다."]

 이런 가운데 한병도 민주당 원내대표가 전북을 찾았습니다.

 한 원내대표는 피지컬 AI 산업과 현대차 새만금 투자 등을 언급하면서 정부·여당과 협력해 전북 발전을 이끌 도지사가 필요하다며, 이원택 후보에 힘을 실었습니다.

 또 김 지사 제명은 윤리감찰단 조사 결과 충분히 납득 가능한 조치였고, 이 후보의 식사비 대납 의혹도 철저히 조사했다고 강조했습니다.

 [한병도/민주당 원내대표 : "이원택 후보에 대해서는 대충 감찰했냐? 그렇지 않습니다. 1차 감찰을 하고요. 미진한 부분이 있다고 해서 또 감찰했습니다."]

 김 지사의 무소속 출마가 전북지사 선거 구도에 큰 변수가 된 가운데 민주당 지도부도 잇따라 지원에 나서며 대응 전략 마련에 집중하고 있습니다.

en-US.title: Floor Leader Han Byung-do backs Lee Won-taek, launches fierce attack on Kim Kwan-young / KBS 05.1...
en-US.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8557893

[Anchor]

Han Byung-do, the Democratic Party's floor leader who recently succeeded in securing a second term, visited Jeonbuk and appealed for support for Jeonbuk Governor candidate Lee Won-taek.

On the other hand, regarding Governor Kim Kwan-young, who has been engaged in a dispute with the Democratic Party leadership since declaring his candidacy as an independent, he strongly criticized the measure of his expulsion, stating that there was no problem with it.

Reporter Jo Kyung-mo reports.

[Report]

Governor Kim Kwan-young, who declared his candidacy as an independent after being expelled from the Democratic Party over allegations of distributing cash.

Claiming to be a victim of the Democratic Party's unfair nomination process, he also expressed his intention to rejoin the party after winning the election.

[Kim Kwan-young / Independent Preliminary Candidate for Jeonbuk Governor / July 7: "I believe I am the true Democratic Party candidate. After the election, I will win, create a symbolic event that restores fairness and justice within the Democratic Party, and then rejoin the party."]

The Democratic Party leadership strongly pushed back.

Secretary General Cho Seung-rae firmly stated that Governor Kim’s decision to run as an independent constitutes a refusal to accept the nomination and a grave act of misconduct, asserting that his reinstatement to the party is impossible.

[Cho Seung-rae / Secretary General of the Democratic Party / Yesterday: "I would like to make it clear that, in accordance with the party constitution and regulations, his reinstatement is permanently impossible because this not only constitutes a refusal to accept the nomination but is also a grave act of misconduct."]

Meanwhile, Democratic Party Floor Leader Han Byung-do visited Jeonbuk.

Floor Leader Han lent his support to Candidate Lee Won-taek, stating that a governor is needed to lead the development of Jeonbuk in cooperation with the government and the ruling party, citing the physical AI industry and Hyundai Motor’s investment in Saemangeum.

He also emphasized that Governor Kim’s expulsion was a fully justifiable measure based on the results of the Ethics Inspection Team’s investigation, and that the allegations regarding Candidate Lee’s payment of meal expenses were also thoroughly investigated. [Han Byung-do / Democratic Party Floor Leader: "Did we conduct a perfunctory inspection of Candidate Lee Won-taek? That is not the case. We conducted a first inspection, and because there were deemed insufficient areas, we conducted another inspection."]

With Governor Kim’s decision to run as an independent becoming a major variable in the landscape of the North Jeolla gubernatorial election, the Democratic Party leadership is stepping forward to offer support and focusing on devising response strategies.

This is Cho Kyung-mo for KBS News.

Cameraman: Kim Dong-gyun

id.title: Ketua Fraksi Han Byung-do Memberikan Dukungan untuk Lee Won-taek, Melancarkan Serangan Sengit ter...
id.description:
https://news.kbs.co.kr/news/pc/view/view.do?ncd=8557893

[Pembawa Acara]

Han Byung-do, ketua fraksi Partai Demokrat yang baru-baru ini berhasil mengamankan masa jabatan kedua, mengunjungi Jeonbuk dan meminta dukungan untuk calon Gubernur Jeonbuk, Lee Won-taek.

Di sisi lain, mengenai Gubernur Kim Kwan-young, yang telah terlibat perselisihan dengan pimpinan Partai Demokrat sejak menyatakan pencalonannya sebagai independen, ia sangat mengkritik tindakan pengusirannya, menyatakan bahwa tidak ada masalah dengan hal itu.

Laporan oleh Reporter Jo Kyung-mo.

[Laporan]

Gubernur Kim Kwan-young, yang menyatakan pencalonannya sebagai independen setelah diusir dari Partai Demokrat atas tuduhan mendistribusikan uang tunai.

Mengaku sebagai korban proses nominasi yang tidak adil dari Partai Demokrat, ia juga menyatakan niatnya untuk bergabung kembali dengan partai setelah memenangkan pemilihan.

[Kim Kwan-young / Calon Independen Sementara Gubernur Jeonbuk / 7 Juli: "Saya yakin saya adalah kandidat Partai Demokrat yang sejati. Setelah pemilihan, saya akan menang, menciptakan peristiwa simbolis yang mengembalikan keadilan dan kesetaraan di dalam Partai Demokrat, dan kemudian bergabung kembali dengan partai."]

Pimpinan Partai Demokrat memberikan tanggapan keras.

Sekretaris Jenderal Cho Seung-rae dengan tegas menyatakan bahwa keputusan Gubernur Kim untuk maju sebagai calon independen merupakan penolakan untuk menerima nominasi dan tindakan pelanggaran berat, menegaskan bahwa pengembaliannya ke partai tidak mungkin dilakukan.

[Cho Seung-rae / Sekretaris Jenderal Partai Demokrat / Kemarin: "Saya ingin memperjelas bahwa, sesuai dengan konstitusi dan peraturan partai, pengembaliannya ke partai tidak mungkin dilakukan secara permanen karena ini bukan hanya merupakan penolakan untuk menerima nominasi tetapi juga tindakan pelanggaran berat."]

Sementara itu, Ketua Fraksi Partai Demokrat Han Byung-do mengunjungi Jeonbuk.

Ketua Fraksi Han memberikan dukungannya kepada Calon Lee Won-taek, menyatakan bahwa seorang gubernur dibutuhkan untuk memimpin pembangunan Jeonbuk bekerja sama dengan pemerintah dan partai yang berkuasa, dengan menyebutkan industri AI fisik dan investasi Hyundai Motor di Saemangeum.

Ia juga menekankan bahwa pemecatan Gubernur Kim adalah tindakan yang sepenuhnya dapat dibenarkan berdasarkan hasil investigasi Tim Inspeksi Etika, dan bahwa tuduhan mengenai pembayaran biaya makan Calon Lee juga telah diselidiki secara menyeluruh. [Han Byung-do / Ketua Fraksi Partai Demokrat: "Apakah kami melakukan inspeksi yang asal-asalan terhadap Calon Lee Won-taek? Bukan begitu. Kami melakukan inspeksi pertama, dan karena ada beberapa area yang dianggap tidak memadai, kami melakukan inspeksi kedua."]

Dengan keputusan Gubernur Kim untuk maju sebagai calon independen menjadi variabel utama dalam lanskap pemilihan gubernur Jeolla Utara, kepemimpinan Partai Demokrat melangkah maju untuk menawarkan dukungan dan berfokus pada penyusunan strategi respons.

Ini Cho Kyung-mo untuk KBS News.


Juru Kamera: Kim Dong-gyun
